items.prompt: A small ferry arriving at a wooden pier on a tropical island in the late afternoon: a single passenger with a backpack seen from behind at the bow, palms and a low green hill ahead, calm water.

alt.ru: Маленький паром подходит к деревянному причалу тропического острова ближе к вечеру: на носу пассажир с рюкзаком со спины, впереди пальмы и зелёный холм.
alt.en: A small ferry nearing a wooden pier on a tropical island in late afternoon: a passenger with a backpack at the bow, seen from behind, palms and a green hill ahead.
alt.pt: Um pequeno ferry a chegar a um cais de madeira numa ilha tropical ao fim da tarde: um passageiro de mochila à proa, de costas, palmeiras e uma colina verde à frente.
alt.es: Un pequeño ferry llegando a un muelle de madera en una isla tropical a última hora de la tarde: un pasajero con mochila en la proa, de espaldas, palmeras y una colina verde delante.
